content.text:
**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — §6.1 (Exclusivity), paragraphs p0036–p0042.

The document does contain a restriction on the Company, contrary to the planner's "likelyAbsent" hint — Section 6.1 in the Exclusivity block. But it lands at the playbook fallback rather than in deviation territory:

| Fallback element | §6.1 |
|---|---|
| Named competing product | Yes — defined "Deerskin Products" + named comparators |
| During term only | Yes — no post-term tail |
| Capped at 12 months | Yes — 1-year term, 90-day exit (§4.1) |
| Carve-outs | Partial — §6.2 closeouts, Joan Cook exclusion, §8(b) Globix |

Two points noted in the rationale but deliberately **not** redlined, per the playbook's treatment of minor sub-elements: there is no express internal-development/acquisitions carve-out, and "products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" is somewhat elastic.

Worth flagging for the deal team as context rather than as a finding: the direction of this bargain runs in our favor. HDI's reciprocal covenant in §6.3 is broader and carries a **two-year post-term tail** that the Company does not bear. Attacking §6.1 would likely invite reciprocal pressure on §6.3, where we hold the better end. No redline proposed.
